newsitem.title: USA: Premier Parks files 4.0 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Premier Parks files 4.0 mln common shares.

text.p: Premier Parks Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the public offering of up to 4.0 million common shares.
Of the total, 3.4 million will be sold the U.S. and Canada and 600,000 shares elsewhere, the company said.

Premier Parks, which operates theme parks across the nation, said it intends to use net proceeds to acquire and make improvements on additional theme parks, fund improvements and expand parks already owned and for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through Lehman Bros., Furman Selz and Smith Barney Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 600,000 additional shares.
